title: hide breadcrumbs on mobile
rule: Hide breadcrumbs on mobile — content starts higher; mobile breadcrumb is hard motorically. Dual-cite USWDS omit-on-home; this is viewport hide, not home omit. Don’t use breadcrumbs on 2–3 level sites.
pass_when: Breadcrumbs are hidden at mobile viewport; not used on 2–3 level sites.
fail_when: Mobile shows a breadcrumb trail; or breadcrumbs are used on a 2–3 level site.
overview: Hide breadcrumbs on mobile viewports; skip them on shallow two-to-three level sites.
apply_when: Wayfinding on deep sites where desktop breadcrumbs help but mobile space is tight.
not_when: Desktop deep hierarchies that still benefit from a breadcrumb trail.
agent_hint: Hide breadcrumbs on mobile; omit them on 2–3 level sites entirely.
description: Suomi.fi hides breadcrumbs on mobile so content starts higher and users avoid a hard motor target; dual-cite USWDS omit-on-home, noting this is viewport hide rather than home omit. Do not use breadcrumbs on two-to-three level sites at all. Showing a mobile trail, or breadcrumbs on a shallow site, fights the guidance and wastes scarce viewport space.
do_not_claim: USWDS omit-on-home as this viewport-hide row.
